∀ {m n : ℕ} (W : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
  have V := ↑⋯.eigenvectorUnitary;
  OracleTemplate.Muon.toMatrix (OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize W) =
    (OracleTemplate.Muon.toMatrix W * V *
        Matrix.diagonal fun i =>
          if 0 < OracleTemplate.Muon.singularValues W i then (OracleTemplate.Muon.singularValues W i)⁻¹ else 0) *
      V.transpose
